scene: The bee buzzes to the transit terminal rooftop.
picture: Flat side view. The player stands centre-left holding her red umbrella, watching the glowing brass bee hover up high. On the far left, a blue ferryboat floats by a wooden pier. At centre sits an open subway stairwell with tiled walls. On the far right, a yellow street tram waits on rails.
shown: a blue ferryboat docked at a wooden pier on the far left
a tiled subway stairwell with an open iron gate at centre
a yellow vintage street tram waiting at a stop on the far right

variants.scene: The clockwork bee hovers above the bustling rooftop transit hub as dusk falls.
Salty harbour air fills the breeze as commuters gather near the transit gates.
The little golden bee hums along to {tune} above the lively terminal.
